faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in Abbotsford: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 1 bedroom condo cost in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in Abbotsford, 90 sold over the past year at a median of $324,950, with the middle half between $288,250 and $349,975.

faq.q: How long does a 1 bedroom condo take to sell in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median was 32 days, and homes sold for 97.8% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Abbotsford neighbourhood has the most 1 bedroom condos sales?
faq.a: Central, with 62 of the 90 sales at a median of $320,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Abbotsford have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Jacob (6 sales, median $319,950); Highstreet Village (5 sales, median $339,900); Montvue (5 sales, median $320,000); Tamarind Westside (4 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in Abbotsford was $300 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 1 bedroom condos in Abbotsford compare

Of the 7 cities with 1 bedroom condo pages, Abbotsford has the lowest median price. Abbotsford is lowest at $324,950 and South Surrey highest at $485,000.
